The Belcar Endurance Championship is the top-tier national endurance racing championship in Belgium. The series is sanctioned by the Royal Automobile Club of Belgium and run by Circuit Zolder.

1952. Start of the legendary 24 hour endurance race at Le Mans. A race steeped in history. The Mercedes returns to the famous circuit after 22 years. And Ferrari uses factory works team cars for the first time.
The Volkswagen Group is the second biggest car company in the world. It all starts in 1936 with one car: the Volkswagen Beetle.
The legendary Pikes Peak International Hillclimb returns to the 156-turn, 12.42-mile mountain course known as "The Race to the Clouds".
Portrait of Ferruccio Lamborghini, who originally built tractors, but then moved on to found one of the most famous sports car factories in the world.
Talking of motorsport without speaking of France is impossible.

The Munich Monster: 700 horsepower. 900 Neuton metre torque, 28-inch wheels. The most powerful Hummer ever built! Also: The Unimog - a true multi-talent. Or - how to avoid paying HGV charges on the motorway.
Today from Friedrichshafen, Southern Germany, where the largest Tuning Fair in Europe takes place every year. The 'Tuning World Lake Constance' - of course we can't miss it.

The Stunt Heroes are testing for a big movie. They are filming a car crash and the idea is that it should look like if the main character of the movie, the actor is really driving the car. They are using filmtricks and a self constructed airbag to reach their goal.

programmes.d: The FIM Supermoto World Championship, also known as S1GP, is the premier international competition for Supermoto racing, first held in 2002.

The FIM Sidecarcross World Championship is an international motocross racing series featuring sidecar motorcycles. In this championship, a rider and a passenger (the "passenger" often referred to as the "passenger" or "monkey") work together to navigate challenging off-road tracks.

Extreme Winter Test: We push the Mercedes G 580 EQ to its limits on the snowy Timmelsjoch High Alpine Road and uncover all the pros and cons of the new electric drivetrain. Does the electric G still feel like a true G-Class? And we get an exclusive drive in the new, still camouflaged CLA.
We visited a Hot Rod Hanger near Vienna with the largest private Mopa Muscle car collection in Europe. The entire collection has been built up by over the last 30 years by a true artist: Knud Tiroch.

Stuntman Dominik Kowalski is an expert for falls, drops and body stunts. But today is different: he is supposed to drive the stunt car! The job: a flip through a cola truck! This is not for the weak-minded! Will Nick fail or is he the right man for this stunt.

Brands from the Far East are turning up the pressure: Kia is expanding its lineup with the compact EV2. We find out what it has to offer against its bigger siblings and the competition. And Geely, China's second-largest car manufacturer, is now aiming to establish a foothold in Europe.

BMW X5M, Audi Q7, Mercedes GLS and Porsche Cayenne turbo are the strongest and fastest SUVs of the world. Sports utility vehicles 'made in Germany'are the embodiment of technical perfection, superior performance and unique comfort.

The days of family minivans are over! Today, it’s SUVs that are expected to provide room for seven passengers plus luggage. At Volkswagen, the Tayron takes over from the Touran. With seemingly endless space and premium-class features, it’s becoming a top choice for families.

It doesn't get boring! Manufacturers of SUVs and off-road vehicles have never offered such a variety of powertrains. From a roaring V8 to quiet electric hum: The new Porsche Cayenne offers the right concept for every fan.

The Nitrolympx is the biggest international drag race event in Europe. Every year 30,000 - 35,000 visitors attend the festival to watch a highly explosive mix of action, show and extreme acceleration. About 300-350 drivers take part in any of the classes that the Nitrolympx has to offer.

The Jaguar XF-S is supposed to put pressure on BMW, Audi and co. in the business class segment. With V6 power, 380 HP output and all-wheel drive it wants to teach the German top dogs the true meaning of the word fear. Volvo takes a different approach.

This years motto of the Conti Tuning Day is 'power sedans' and Tuning host Lucy examines the bolides carefully. Plus: The McLaren SLR is the masterpiece of Mercedes, a super sports car among all sports cars. Only 3.500 units have been produced.
